description: Compact the admin panel by grouping features into sub-menus. Currently admin_main_kb() has 20+ buttons. Reduce to ~8-10 buttons by grouping related features under sub-menus accessible via new reply keyboard buttons.
steps: Create new admin sub-menu button constants: BTN_ADM_REPORTS = _b('📊 Reports'), BTN_ADM_TOOLS = _b('🔧 Tools'), BTN_ADM_ORDERS = _b('📋 Orders')

Redesign admin_main_kb() to show only compact main menu (8-10 buttons max): Dashboard, Products, Stock, Users, Deposits, Orders (sub-menu), Reports (sub-menu), Tools (sub-menu), Settings, Home. This reduces from 22 buttons to ~10.
Create admin_orders_submenu_kb() with: VPN Orders, Proxy Orders, Order Lookup, Export Mail Orders, Back, Home
Create admin_reports_submenu_kb() with: Analytics, Profit Calculator, Export Transactions, Activity Logs, Back, Home
Create admin_tools_submenu_kb() with: Low Stock Alerts, Service Status, Price Sync, Auto Import, Roles, Broadcast, Coupons, Data Packages, Back, Home
Add new FSM states or reuse AdminFlow.menu for sub-menus. Add AdminFlow.orders_submenu, AdminFlow.reports_submenu, AdminFlow.tools_submenu states.
Add message handlers for the new sub-menu buttons (BTN_ADM_REPORTS, BTN_ADM_TOOLS, BTN_ADM_ORDERS) that set the appropriate state and show the sub-menu keyboard.
Update the BACK_BTN handler in admin context: when in a sub-menu state, pressing Back returns to admin_main_kb() instead of going all the way home.
Ensure all existing admin feature handlers still trigger correctly from their sub-menus (the button text constants remain the same, just the keyboards showing them change).
acceptance_criteria: admin_main_kb() shows 10 or fewer buttons (excluding Home)
All admin features remain accessible through sub-menus
Sub-menus have Back button that returns to admin main menu
No functionality is lost - all admin features still work
verification: grep -A 20 'def admin_main_kb' bot.py | grep -c 'BTN_ADM' should show ~7-8 buttons (compact)
grep 'admin_orders_submenu_kb\|admin_reports_submenu_kb\|admin_tools_submenu_kb' bot.py should find all three sub-menu functions
